fixed_dose.source: Brief v2 section 5 MASS: 'drop the lowest-ranked 10% / add the next-ranked 10%'; identical dose to the R0 exact-marginal MASS session so the two parent reads pair cleanly

r10minus.operation: drop the 3,765 lowest exact-marginal-DTI dots from the full 37,654-dot R1 set
r10minus.reason: On R0 the identical 10% drop measured -0.00843 w-model and -0.00806 blind SGMC delta; the random-donor control put the pure -10% dose effect at -0.00623. R1 has no sub-3 px collar dead mass left to shed and its 2,171 refills were themselves exact-marginal picks, so the greedy drop cannot do better than the R0 read; it removes kernel coverage from a gate-clean, already-refilled field. Slightly less negative than the R0 point estimate only because R1's mean per-dot support is marginally stronger, making the lowest decile marginally less costly.

r10plus.operation: add the 3,765 next-ranked un-emitted dots (H19-5 support, d_cat > 3 px, never emitted by R1)
r10plus.reason: The R0 add arm was MASS's only positive arm (+0.01074 w-model, +0.00286 blind SGMC; pure +10% dose effect +0.00110 under random receivers). R1's PRUNE refill already consumed the 2,171 highest-gain >3 px cells of that same H19-5 pool, so the residual pool is deeper into kernel-saturation territory (98.2% of R0 additions landed within 3 px of an existing dot) and the expected gain is roughly halved. This is the gate-clean form of the queued experiment and the only arm with a positive prior.

r10swap.operation: count-matched substitution: drop the 3,765 lowest-ranked R1 dots and add the 3,765 next-ranked un-emitted dots (d_cat > 3 px); count held at 37,654
r10swap.reason: S is frozen so only ranking quality can move DTI. On R0 the swap read +0.00294 w-model but -0.00401 blind SGMC because w's blind AUC for SGMC-credited dots is 0.4724 (IR-88-38); the random control bounds the w-ranking effect at about +/-0.0018. With R1's pool further depleted the net expectation is approximately zero and the arm is a diagnostic on whether exact-marginal ranking adds anything once the parent is itself an exact-marginal product.
